ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite PET Tau Detailed Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_PET_Tau_Detailed.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite PET Tau Detailed Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_PET_Tau_Detailed)

Format

A data frame with 2278 observations and 192 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI4, ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI4, ADNI3, ADNI2

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • PHC_LONIUID numeric LONI Image ID Range value: 513671, ..., 11394000

  • PHC_SCANDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized visit number Range value: 1, ..., 18

  • PHC_Age_PET numeric Participant's Age at PET Data Collection Range value: 50.7843942505133, ..., 96.0602327173169

  • PHC_TRACER character PET Radiotracer , with options: FTP, MK, PI

  • PHC_TRACER_SUVR_WARNING character Reminder of the incomparability of SUVRs from different tracers. Refer to ADSP PET Methods Document , with options: DO NOT COMBINE TRACERS

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_START numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 45, ..., 90

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_END numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 75, ..., 110

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_TIME numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection 1 = 30-60 ; 2 = 40-60 ; 3 = 40-70 ; 4 = 45-75 ; 5 = 45-90 ; 6 = 50-70 ; 7 = 60-90 ; 8 = 70-90 ; 9 = 70-110 ; 10 = 80-100 ; 11 = 90-110 ; 12 = 30-45 ; 99 = outside of acceptable range

  • PHC_QC_IMAGE numeric Determination if scan passed or failed quality control– image quality 0 = Fail ; 1 = Pass ; 2 = Pending

  • PHC_QC_TIMING numeric Determination if scan passed or failed quality control– acquisition time 0 = Fail ; 1 = Pass ; 2 = Pending

  • PHC_QC_NOTES numeric Notes related to failed quality control. 1 = Abnormal image ; 2 = Technical problem ; 3 = Anatomic abnormality ; 4 = Bottom of brain cut ; 5 = Early finish ; 6 = Early start ; 7 = Front of brain cut ; 8 = High glucose ; 9 = Late start ; 10 = Motion-induced attenuation artifact ; 11 = No attenuation or scatter correction ; 12 = Scan aborted early ; 13 = Severe motion ; 14 = Top of brain cut ; 15 = Wrong reconstruction parameters (16) Wrong voxel size ; 88 = Pass/Pending ; 99 = Other

  • PHC_COMPLIANT_ACQUISITION_START numeric Tracer-specific compliant acquisition start time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 45, ..., 90

  • PHC_COMPLIANT_ACQUISITION_END numeric Tracer-specific compliant acquisition stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 75, ..., 110

  • PHC_INJECTED_DOSE numeric Measure of injected radioligand dose (millicurie) Range value: 10, ..., 10

  • PHC_DYNAMIC numeric Whether dynamic (multiple frames available) or static 1 = static ; 2 = dynamic

  • B12_SUVR numeric SUVR of B1/B2 normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellum Range value: 0.783, ..., 3.254

  • B3_SUVR numeric SUVR of B3 normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellum Range value: 0.821, ..., 3.025

  • B4_SUVR numeric SUVR of B4 normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellum Range value: 0.772, ..., 3.391

  • B5_SUVR numeric SUVR of B5 normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellum Range value: 0.751, ..., 3.415

  • B6_SUVR numeric SUVR of B6 normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellum Range value: 0.652, ..., 2.31

  • META_TEMPORAL_SUVR numeric Meta temporal SUVR normalized by inferior cerebellar grey matter. Range value: 0.837, ..., 3.641

  • CTX_ENTORHINAL_SUVR numeric Volume-weighted mean SUVR of ctx-lh-entorhinal and ctx-rh-entorhinal normalized by inferior cerebellar grey matter; ROI volume is provided in MRI-Free NPDKA Appendix CSV on LONI Range value: 0.783, ..., 3.254

  • INFERIORCEREBELLUM_SUVR numeric Reference region - SUVR of NPDKA inferior cerebellar grey matter; See SCAN MRI-Free Tau PET methods document on LONI Range value: 1, ..., 1

  • ERODED_SUBCORTICALWM_SUVR numeric Reference region - SUVR of NPDKA eroded subcortical white matter normalized by NPDKA inferior cerebellar grey matter; See SCAN MRI-Free Tau PET Methods document on LONI Range value: 0.453, ..., 1.886

  • BRAINSTEM_SUVR numeric brain-stem SUVR normalized by inferior cerebellar grey matter; ROI volume is provided in MRI-Free NPDKA Appendix CSV on LONI Range value: 0.568, ..., 1.36
